title: 05/03/19 - Software Updates
text:
## 05/03/19 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000057052
We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.
We updated the logic of the Listing Search Results H1 Title. Now if the /search_results SEO Template H1 Title is empty, the system will display the Feature Search Results Title as a backup. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Member Feature Search Results H1
We fixed an issue which was causing the Write a Review Button to display slightly out of alignment on Member Profile pages in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Header
We updated the UI of the Leads Details page in the Member Dashboard to display the content of the lead more clearly on mobile devices. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Leads Details Page - New Lead System
We fixed a display issue with the 301 Redirect Search Filter Field causing the search icon to overlap with the text.
We updated the URL of the Menu Manager page in the Admin.
We fixed a design issue on the Member Account Details page in the Admin which was causing the "Cancelled" text to display without the proper background color when a member's status is Cancelled.
We fixed an issue which was causing the scroll bar to get stuck when viewing a code editor in the Admin.
We created a new Design Setting to control the background color of post images on Post Search Results and Post Details pages. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Design Settings tab >> Additional Design Setting section. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings
The Category dropdowns on Lead Forms on member profile pages will now display all Sub Categories when the member is automatically added to all categories in their Product's settings. Widget Involved: Bootstrap - Contact Member Category Dropdowns
We added Search Filter Options to the Email Templates page in the Admin to allow Email Templates to be filtered by Keyword or Category.
We improved the logic of the Email Notification badge in order to only take into consideration un-read and un-archived Form Inquiry records.
Select2 dropdown fields marked as required in the Form Manager will now be treated as required when displayed on a site. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Form
We created a new Design Setting to control whether or not a "View All' button on displays in the Recent Member homepage widget. In order to use this new feature, navigates to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >>Homepage Layout Tab >> Homepage Section Order Options. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Members
We fixed an issue with the sort order of Reviews on Profile pages.  Now the most recent reviews will be displayed first. Widget Involved: Search - Reviews - Search Query
We fixed an issue which was causing the Member Search Results H1 Title to show twice when performing a member keyword search in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Member Feature Search Results H1
We applied a design fix to the "Reply to Review" field in the Member Review Details page in order to expand the textarea vertically. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Form - Display Rating Options
We fixed an issue which was causing Member Search Sidebar widgets to not auto-select the searched Sub and Sub-Sub Categories after performing a search. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Footer - Scripts Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Sub + Sub-Sub Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Sub_Sub_Sub_Location Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Top_Sub_Category Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Top_Sub_Location Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Top_Sub_Sub-Sub_Location
We added Bulk Actions functionality to the View Members page in the Admin. This new feature will enable Site Admins to change the Status or Product of a Member, or Delete members in bulk.
We fixed an issue which was causing upgrade options to display a price when the Product had been marked as Free in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Upgrade Page 1
We updated the description of the Require Location and Require Category settings on the Lead Settings page in the Admin.
Location searches for posts now support the Strict Search Advanced Setting. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Form - Member Google Location Search - Group - Search Query Search - Post - Search Query
We fixed an issue which was causing a website's logo to not link to the homepage of the site properly when displayed on securemypayment.com payment pages. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Header - Left
We updated the display of the Import Member page in the Admin.
